title: anthericum latifolium
intro: Anthericum latifolium, commonly known as Star of Bethlehem or Ornament of Bethlehem, is a plant species belonging to the family Asparagaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation and pain, as well as promoting relaxation and sleep. The bioactive constituents of Anthericum latifolium include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
